title: 审批中心批量审批：失败的行只列记录名，不说为什么失败
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① an experience defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7122552986, item 2). Source: L1 on PR #36846 (#36463), item N2, with the PR's own "Not covered" note. It existed before that PR.

## What happens

In the Approval Center, a bulk approve or reject that partly fails shows a toast like "3 succeeded, 2 failed: 报价单 A, 报价单 B". It names the failed rows by record title only, at most three of them, and never says why each one failed.

On main 5c2e34cd, `runBulk` in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` (~line 1383) catches each failure with a bare `catch {}` and keeps only the title. The refusal's own text is dropped. After #36846, that includes the localized `userMessage` the server now sends for a submitter refusal. The single-row Approve already shows that text.

reach: read from code, not measured in a browser. It reaches approvers who bulk-act on a selection where some requests are refused, for example their own submission or one already decided.

## Expected

The user can tell why each failed row failed, in their language, and can act on it.

## Acceptance

- Each failure keeps the refusal's user-facing text (`userMessage` when present, through the same reader the single-row Approve uses), else a generic line.
- The partial-failure feedback shows each failed row with its reason. When there are more failures than fit in a toast, all of them can still be reached.
- A test drives a bulk approve with one refused row and asserts that the reason is shown.

Dedupe: open issues for Approval Center bulk approve and for bulk approve failure reasons return none.
